title: Valley Between Two Halves
description: A half-time dubstep frame at 140 carried by emotive felt-piano chords and a wobbling sub. It opens dreamy, swells into a swung garage half, sinks into a long dark breakdown valley, then rises again heavier before fading on room and delay.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.5).gain(0.7).lpf(1400),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.8)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.45).gain(0.7).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4)),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.9),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.18, 8),
    note("<c1 ab0 bb0 g0>").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(2).range(150, 800)).shape(0.3).gain(0.9)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.75).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4)),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.95),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.18, 8).cut(1),
    s("~ rim ~ rim*3").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.45).swingBy(0.12, 8),
    note("<c1 ab0 bb0 g0>").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(1.5).range(120, 1100)).shape(0.4).crush(8).gain(0.95),
    s("think").chop(8).speed("<1 1 0.5 1.5>").gain(0.5).room(0.3).every(4, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.7).gain(0.7).delay(".4:.166:.6").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(700, 2000)),
    s("swpad").n(2).gain(0.5).room(0.6).slow(2),
    note("<c1 ab0>").s("sine").lpf(400).gain(0.7).room(0.3)
  )],
  [28, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,ab3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("piano").room(0.4).gain(0.75).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.45)),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.0),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.2, 8).cut(1),
    s("~ rim ~ rim*3").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.12, 8),
    note("<c1 ab0 bb0 g0>").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(1).range(110, 1300)).shape(0.45).crush(8).gain(1.0).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("think").chop(8).speed("<1 0.5 1.5 1>").gain(0.55).room(0.3).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2))
  )],
  [12, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("piano").room(0.6).gain(0.65).delay(".5:.166:.5").lpf(1300),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.7),
    note("<c1 ab0>").s("sine").lpf(350).gain(0.6).room(0.4)
  )]
)
